These SVGs are a small subset of the default public assets from
https://github.com/huilang-me/CF-Server-Monitor/ (main, version 2.8.6).
The accompanying LICENSE is the upstream MIT license.

They are used only by the isolated local demo / browser test server so previews
display actual region flags and operating-system icons. They are not included in
the theme's dist directory; deployed themes continue using the backend's
/flags/ and /os-icons/ resources.
